title: ToolCall
description: Liuye 5-protocol member · ToolCall + ProgressMessage (v3 spec §2.3). Self-describing tool invocation envelope (CC pattern). status fixed at 8 enum · invoker_id/reviewer_id added per P0-8 R9 (audit chain) · parent_tool_call_id links Cowork → Managed handoff. ProgressMessage nested via definitions · its own 5-state status enum (not the 8-state ToolCall.status). ToolDefinition (renderToolCall / inputSchema / outputSchema) is consumer-side TS · NOT modeled here.

id.description: ToolCall identifier · unique within a turn. Referenced by Artifact.source_tool_call_id and LiuyeChatEvent.tool_call_id.

schema_version.description: Liuye contract schema version · fixed '1' for the current spec lock.

turn_id.description: Parent conversation turn identifier · same across all events within one user turn.

agent.description: 6-agent enum (v3 §2.3 verbatim · root §4 SSOT). Cowork: channel/credit/report. Managed: alert/compliance/riskctrl.

tool_id.description: Stable tool identifier · resolves to a ToolDefinition (consumer-side TS · Zod inputSchema/outputSchema).

boundary.description: Tool boundary type per root §3.1.1. cowork = real-time SSE (< 5s p95) · managed_readonly = batch (job_id + status + retry).

parent_tool_call_id.description: Optional · Cowork → Managed handoff link. Set when this ToolCall was spawned by another ToolCall (e.g. Agent3 cowork credit decision triggers Agent5 managed compliance scan).

invoker_id.description: P0-8 R9 · the persona/user that triggered this tool_call. Required for audit chain (decision_ledger lookup · LE-05 sign-off). For system-triggered managed jobs (cron / event), set to 'system:<job_kind>'.

reviewer_id.description: P0-8 R9 · the reviewer who signed off on this tool_call. Set for LE-05 sign-off / high-risk PermissionRequest approvals. NULL for normal flow.

input.description: Tool input · validated by inputSchema.safeParse() consumer-side (Zod). Open schema here · per-tool narrowing happens at inputSchemas.ts.

status.description: ToolStatus 8-enum lock (v3 §2.3 line 179-181 verbatim · brief §4.2 hardline). Lifecycle: queued → connecting → running → streaming → (completed|failed|aborted|idle_timeout). idle_timeout = no progress emitted within SLA window (per agent SLA · root §3.1.1).

progress.description: ProgressMessage list · monotonic seq · emitted via SSE tool.progress events.

result.description: Tool result · validated by outputSchema consumer-side (Zod). Set when status transitions to completed. Open schema here · per-tool narrowing at inputSchemas.ts.

code.description: Error code · machine-readable enum (e.g. TOOL_TIMEOUT, INPUT_VALIDATION, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE).

message.description: Human-readable error message · displayed to operator (RM/审贷员/合规官).

error.description: Set when status = failed. Mirrors TurnErrorPayload shape (subset) per liuye_chat_event.schema.json.

artifact_id.description: Optional · the Artifact.id produced by this tool_call (Cowork agents only · Managed agents write to decision_ledger instead per root §3.1.1).

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC · set when status transitions to completed/failed/aborted/idle_timeout.

tool_call_id.description: Parent ToolCall.id this progress belongs to.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence · emitted in order from the same tool_call. Client uses seq to detect gaps and trigger reconnect (per liuye_chat_event.schema.json reconnect rules).

stage_key.description: Internal stage key · stable identifier (e.g. 'kb_scan', 'evidence_collect', 'llm_grounded_gen') · appears in tooltip/trace · NOT for end-user display.

stage_label.description: Chinese-facing stage label (e.g. '知识库扫描', '证据汇集', 'LLM 接地生成') · displayed to operator in progress UI.

stage_total.description: Optional · total stage count in pipeline. stage_index < stage_total.

percent.description: Optional · progress percent 0-100 integer (per matrix §3 Q1 decision · NOT float). 100 = stage done.

status.description: ProgressMessage status 5-enum (v3 §2.3 line 207 verbatim). DIFFERENT from ToolCall.status 8-enum · ProgressMessage status is stage-level lifecycle (warning = stage degraded but pipeline continues · error = stage fatal · upgrades ToolCall.status to failed at next emit).

detail.description: Optional · free-form detail string (e.g. '已扫 12/45 KB doc'). Shown in progress drawer expandable section.

ProgressMessage.description: ProgressMessage (v3 §2.3 line 195-209). Tool-call lifecycle stage progress · emitted via tool.progress SSE event.
